## Checklist
Please verify the following before submitting:
- [ ] All tasks use FQCN (Fully Qualified Collection Name)
- [ ] `ansible-lint` passes
- [ ] Syntax check passes
- [ ] Molecule tests pass (if applicable)
- [ ] Variables are in `snake_case`
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets
- [ ] Tags are defined on all tasks
- [ ] Handlers are used for service restarts
